name: h3-ood-restyle-v1
status: default OOD route for tabletop material/colour and light colour temperature on top of an ACCEPTED H3 sim2real render; task-agnostic, not a task qualification
description: Output-side OOD appearance edit: content (robot, objects, motion, contacts) is the accepted sim2real video, untouched; only the authorized axes change. Gains and recolouring only: no pixel is moved or retimed.

authorization.required: mode=ood with authorized_ood_axes from the current user's in-scope instruction (task bundle mode_confirmations.ood); this file grants no OOD authorization
authorization.unsupported: any robot, task-object, camera, layout or background change; textured tabletop materials in moving wrist cameras (the texture cannot follow the camera: re-render the white carrier with a textured table in simulation instead)

source.requires: the accepted sim2real package of the same episode (final-t3-<fps>fps.mp4 + carrier-t3-<fps>fps.mp4 + assembled.json), e.g. the h3-control-hybrid-v1 exposure-lock output
source.review_status_required: accepted by the independent blind review (EVAL-v1)

steps.output: <run>/ood-masks/<task>-<panel>.npy (tabletop masks tracked on the GENERATED video, re-prompted every 96 frames)

args.material_bgr: <B,G,R of the authorized material, e.g. 104,98,92 for slate-grey laminate>
args.light: one of warm-amber-2700k | warm-3000k | neutral-5000k | cool-6500k | cool-blue-7500k (mean-preserving BGR gains)

steps.method: table pixels = target material x (generated luminance / smooth table luminance), keeping generated shadows, contacts and noise; carrier-known white objects are subtracted from the SAM mask and table cast shadows are added; when SAM loses the table the carrier-measured table is used for that frame

generation_side_alternative.route: render the white carrier with h3-control-hybrid-v1 in mode=ood (OOD contract) and assemble ONE seed across all chunks

evaluation.automatic: evaluations/render-h3/h3eval.py score (OOD packages are scored like sim2real; KID against the real pool is expected to rise with the authorized change)
evaluation.acceptance: independent blind review per evaluations/render-h3/reviewer-instructions-v1.md with mode=ood and the stated OOD change
